The Chinese characters for Katherine

As a transliteration, Katherine is usually written 凯瑟琳 (Kǎi sè lín). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

凯
Kǎi
triumphant, victorious
瑟
sè
a zither (transliteration)
琳
lín
beautiful jade

Origin and meaning

From Greek, Katherine carries the meaning “pure”.

About the name Katherine

The name of the actress Katharine Hepburn and of Saint Catherine of Alexandria.

As a gift or a tattoo

The name Katherine suits a framed gift, and the clean high-resolution file also works as a tattoo design.
